description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Attach Water 3 with Stacking], [Synchro Mode], [Damage Cap +10000], [YRP Mode] and [Break Buster Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Attach Water 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3

description.name: Synchro Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands

description.name: YRP Mode
description.text: Grants [Water Ability +20% Boost 1]/[Water Ability +30% Boost 1]/[Water Ability +50% Boost 1]/[Water Ability +70% Boost 1], [Dualcast Water 1]/[Triplecast Water 1]/[Quadracast Water 1]/[Pentacast Water 1] and -/-/[100% Critical 1]/[100% Critical 1] after using Luck if the character has Luck level 1/2/3/4, sets the character's Luck level to 0 after using a Water abilty

description.name: Break Buster Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Break Buster after using Luck
